core_obligations: Show the counting function is constructible on the closure of the given point.
Compare its value on a dense open with the value at the generic point to conclude constancy.

proof_roadmap.step: Restrict to the closure of the point and recall constructibility of the count.
Identify the count on the generic fibre.
Spread the value to a nonempty open.

difficulty_reason: For a finite type morphism, the function counting geometrically irreducible components of the fibres is shown to be constant on a nonempty open subset of the closure of any given point of the base. The proof restricts to the closure of the point, uses the constructibility of the function together with the fact that the generic fibre of the restriction has a definite count, and then spreads the count to a dense open of the closure. Combining constructibility with the generic value is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 7751-7791.
